specs.label: Oil filter

todo.title: Replace both headlights
todo.notes: Replacing both halogen headlight assemblies as a straight swap: Valeo 46658 (driver/left) and Valeo 46659 (passenger/right), $391.95 each, bulbs included, $783.90 total with free shipping. The passenger side had water inside the lens. DIY: open the hood, use the release tool in the access hole at the top of each headlight to push it forward, unplug, slide the new one in and tighten. Aim the lights afterward.

todo.title: Interior dome and rear passenger overhead lights not working
todo.notes: Front dome lights and rear passenger overhead lights are both out. Check the interior lighting fuse first, then bulbs and door switches. Recommended to have Zippo's Car Stereo (Belleville) diagnose this along with the other aftermarket electrical issues.

todo.title: Passenger front seat back panel coming off
todo.notes: Rear panel on the passenger seat back is separating. It's held on with double-sided adhesive strips. Fix: remove old adhesive, clean both surfaces with isopropyl alcohol, re-stick with automotive double-sided tape (e.g. 3M VHB or 3M auto attachment tape), press firmly and let it cure.

todo.title: Exhaust leak heard by mechanic
todo.notes: Mechanic who worked on the car heard an exhaust leak; louder than normal but no running problems noticed. Have the source pinpointed (manifold gasket, flex pipe or a joint/clamp). Listen for ticking on cold start and watch for exhaust smell in the cabin.

todo.title: Paint and detail: roof, bumper, hood, rear door, trim
todo.notes:
Clear coat failing on the roof and bumper and hazy on the hood; rear driver door gloss doesn't match; trim paint chipping. Estimate about $2,750-5,650 at an independent NJ body shop and detailer, budgeting ~$4,200 (black metallic, large SUV panels; dealer shops run higher):
- Roof respray: $800-1,600
- Front bumper respray: $450-900
- Hood respray: $450-900 (less if it polishes out)
- Rear driver door clear and blend: $400-800
- Trim refinish or touch-up: $150-400
- Detailing, two-step paint correction on the whole car: $400-800
- Paint sealant: $100-250 (ceramic coating instead: $500-1,200)
Order: paint first, then correct and blend, then wait about 30 days for new paint to cure before sealing. Paint quotes: Quality Automall (Rutherford), Jersey Auto Body (Passaic), Dynamic Collision (East Rutherford). Detailing: JD Auto Detailing (Clifton) or Get Right Mobile Detailing. Ask each body shop to quote all panels in one visit, whether they blend into adjacent panels, and whether the hood and door can be polished instead of painted.

todo.title: Replace front wiper blades
todo.notes: Safety item: front wipers streaking and worn out. Easy DIY. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Cooling system hoses are original
todo.notes: Hoses look original. Worth replacing together with the thermostat housing to save on labor and coolant. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Replace spark plugs
todo.notes: Spark plugs worn or fouled. Also on the factory schedule; log it as Spark plugs when done to reset the countdown. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208). Estimate: about $400-500 at TJA (about 1-1.5 hr at their ~$177/hr rate plus plugs and tax), or about $130-240 DIY. Genuine Porsche plugs 955 170 219 90, set of 6. Coils sit on top of the plugs; check them for cracked insulators while they're out.

todo.title: Control arm bushings cracked and torn
todo.notes: Replace the control arms and get an alignment afterward. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208). TJA Auto Care estimate 10/6/2026 (order 11622, valid 30 days): $1,884.60 incl. tax. 2 control arms $1,148 ($574 each), lower bushings R&R 2.5 hr $442.50, four-wheel alignment $177. Shop quoted OEM parts.

todo.title: Front and rear struts look original
todo.notes: Technician flagged them for review, not replacement yet. Ask how they look and ride; plan for them at some point. From TJA Auto Group inspection, 10/6/2026, RO 11622, 89,308 mi (161 Ridge Rd, Lyndhurst, 201-935-2208).

todo.title: Aftermarket backup camera not working
todo.notes: Camera was installed with the aftermarket Android head unit. Check: head unit camera settings (reverse trigger enabled), reverse trigger wire to the reverse light circuit, power to the camera, video cable connection at the back of the head unit, and the camera itself. Recommended to have Zippo's Car Stereo (Belleville) diagnose this along with the other aftermarket electrical issues.

todo.title: Loud engine: catalytic converter
todo.notes: TJA mechanic (10/28/2026) said the loud engine sound is mostly from the catalytic converter. It's a costly replacement but not a failure issue, so it can wait. He also noted these engines are just loud to begin with. Fuel use still worth tracking over a few fill-ups, and the overdue spark plugs and air filter may help. Get a quote before deciding.

todo.title: Aftermarket electrical diagnosis at Zippo's (Belleville)
todo.notes: TJA recommended (10/28/2026) taking the car to Zippo's Car Stereo (745 Washington Ave, Belleville) to look at the radio and electrical issues, since they likely trace back to the aftermarket head unit and backup camera install. Have them check: backup camera not working, interior dome and rear overhead lights out, and the head unit wiring/fuses.

todo.title: Sunglasses holder button missing
todo.notes: The small push button on the overhead sunglasses holder is missing. Options: buy a replacement button or the whole holder (search the part number on the holder, or used ones from Cayenne parts sellers on eBay), or 3D print a replacement button.

todo.title: Exterior trim paint chipping
todo.notes: Paint or coating on the exterior trim is chipping. Note which pieces when getting body shop quotes; options are touch-up, refinishing the trim, or replacing the pieces. Could be done alongside the respray. Priced in the paint and detail item so it isn't counted twice.

todo.title: Rear driver door looks repainted, less glossy
todo.notes: Rear driver door looks like it was repainted before: the color is close and the surface is smooth, like it has some clear coat, but the gloss doesn't match the rest of the car. Likely a different clear or one that was never cut and polished, so a machine polish may bring it close; if not, it needs a fresh clear blended into the panel. Ask the body shops and include it in the paint quotes. Priced in the paint and detail item so it isn't counted twice.

todo.title: Overland two-tone wrap instead of full repaint
todo.notes:
Alternative to the paint and detail item. Satin black on the surfaces that face up or take hits, gloss black body in between:
- Satin black roof (under the roof rack) and hood: $550-1,100
- Satin black lower body (lower bumper, rockers, bottom of the doors): $600-1,200
- Blacked-out trim (covers the chipping trim item): $200-500
- Satin black mirror caps: $50-150
- Correct and polish the remaining gloss paint, including the rear driver door: $500-1,000
About $1,900-3,950 total, budgeting ~$3,000. The failing clear on the roof, hood and bumper must be sanded flush before wrapping. Cast vinyl lasts about 4-7 years. Shown as an option, so it isn't added to the planned total.

todo.title: Rhythmic "eh eh eh" noise when lifting off the gas
todo.notes: Faint rhythmic "eh eh eh eh" sound for a moment while driving, right after lifting off the accelerator (on deceleration) (noticed 10/28/2026). Happens while driving, so most likely the driveline: the driveshaft center support bearing is a known weak spot on the 955 and gets noisy on load changes; also check wheel bearings and brake pad wear indicators. Rule out the new drive belt/tensioner from 10/28 (TJA warranty) by revving in Park. Have TJA road-test it and inspect the driveshaft center bearing. Lift-off timing also fits the exhaust leak puffing on deceleration, so have that checked in the same visit.
